QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` when assembly is enabled. Otherwise it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`... This stops the compiler from proving a value and turning the mask arithmetic back into a `cmp`/`jcc`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the empty `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` with the value as an in-out register operand and says it exists to stop compiler optimisation. It never says outright that no instruction is emitted, but an empty asm string implies that.
